blocks.text: **AI agent assist** inside the care and network consoles. It answers staff questions from live data. Bills and failures come with an explanation and a suggested next step.

items.a: **AI agent assist** is an assistant that sits beside a care agent or engineer, answers their questions from live data and suggests the next step, while the person stays in control.

items.q: Can it change anything on its own?
items.a: No. AI Agent Assist is read-only. In the TACACS+ console, recommendations are drafts only.

items.q: Does it help NOC engineers as well as care agents?
items.a: Yes. The same assistant works in the CRM for care teams and in the AAA and TACACS+ consoles for **AI NOC** work.

blocks.text: AI Agent Assist is built into three consoles, and it is in beta in each of them. It reads Alepo console data only. In the TACACS+ console it explains who was allowed to do what, with draft-only recommendations. On the new CRM customer page it uses 14 read-only tools, in English and French as well as Arabic, so an agent can answer a billing question without leaving the page. The AAA console version was built from a large fiber operator's top 18 support cases. It can also run on the operator's own language model, with performance boundaries agreed first.
